subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram provider intermittently stalls despite stable direct Bot API connectivity

question: Should maintainers repair or replace the open proxy-scheme PR as the canonical fix for Telegram SOCKS5 transport stalls, covering both explicit and environment proxy routes before this issue can close?
rationale: The code and Undici contract make the SOCKS5 failure plausible, but the remaining work changes shared proxy transport behavior and still lacks current live Telegram proof.

options.title: Repair Or Replace The Proxy Fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84582 or a replacement to implement scheme-aware shared proxy handling, tests, and live Telegram SOCKS5 proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Wait For Reporter Reproduction
options.body: Keep this issue open only for current-release service-context diagnostics if maintainers do not want to touch shared proxy behavior without a live repro.

options.title: Decline Core Proxy Change
options.body: Leave the current documented proxy guidance in place and close only after maintainers decide SOCKS5 transport quirks belong outside OpenClaw core.

recommendation.title: Repair Or Replace The Proxy Fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/84582 or a replacement to implement scheme-aware shared proxy handling, tests, and live Telegram SOCKS5 proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the shared Undici proxy helper that steipete introduced and recently maintained.
